verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs mention CEL expressions used in "event filters," which implies rule-like conditions that decide which events trigger workflows. A community user also praises its "UI with triggers." However, there is no detailed documentation of defining event-triggered rules or how events map to actions. Cron triggers are schedule-based, not event-based, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit docs on event-triggered workflow definitions, detail on how filter rules bind events to actions, hands-on corroboration of rule-based event automation.
